license: MIT; preserve upstream copyright and bundled notices
architecture: Independent PostgreSQL/Redis/workers; native MVP secondary site page with backend API credentials, no shared session or database
scope: Website creation/binding with stable UUID retry
Native referral, visitor, crawler, content coverage and conversion reports
WordPress MU plugin installation and disable, excludes logged-in/preview traffic
Success-only enquiry events without form contents
Manual scoped content/log import; archive excludes public collection
No crawler policy writes, consumer-answer claims or generated analytics

deployment.build: Pinned unchanged upstream Dockerfile on GitHub Actions; checksum-verified Docker image loaded on host
deployment.initial_data: MVP deployment omits optional demonstration seed; bundled dataset remains in image
deployment.geography: No geographic database configured; missing geographic evidence remains unknown

limits: Advanced session-only crawler controls and GEO weight are not exposed
MCP is disabled; native reports use scoped backend APIs
Automatic server/CDN collectors require separately verified source configuration
Public collection uses trusted proxy IP and site Origin; Origin alone is not proof of a human visitor
